title: Other fairs and parks the band played
summary: Besides Dallas, they played fairground parks in Kansas City and Waco.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: And I found the change in the years. Did you ever play any other state fairs? You want to start it by now or is it?

No, no, the state fairs that I can remember. We played places where the fairs were held in such as in Kansas City. We played at the park in that, Farrowland Park. And over here in Waco, Texas, there's a big park there where they used to have them. We played in that one. Yeah, it's quite a number of places where the fairs were held, but never another fair.
